subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB369
title: Prohibits the Governor and specified state agencies from taking measures to reduce greenhouse gas emissions in Oregon unless authorized by the Legislative Assembly by law enacted on or after the effective date of the Act.
headline: SB 369 did not pass

claims.text: SB 369 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 369 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
